components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:14px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-ref{display:inline-block;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d5dbe2);border-radius:6px;background:var(--card,#f4f6f8);color:var(--fg,#1b1f24);font:12px/18px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;text-decoration:none}.ds-ref:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#1d5fc2);color:var(--accent,#1d5fc2)}.ds-chip{padding:0 7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d5dbe2);border-radius:999px;color:var(--accent,#1d5fc2);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:18px;text-decoration:none}.ds-ref:focus-visible,.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1d5fc2);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}.ds-code{padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--neutral-bg,#eceff3);color:var(--neutral,#59616c);font:700 12px/18px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-code[data-tone=wait]{background:var(--wait-bg,#fcf3d9);color:var(--wait,#8f5e00)}.ds-count{display:inline-block;min-width:22px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--neutral-bg,#eceff3);color:var(--fg,#1b1f24);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-count[data-worst=fail]{background:var(--fail-bg,#fdecec);color:var(--fail,#c4262e)}

narrative.overview:
The fleet is an on-call desk. Everything that needs the operator is an open item: a blocked screen, a failure, a decision or an unread report. Items are paged in one fixed severity order, acknowledged in place, and resolved into the timeline. The operator opens the board and knows at once whether anything is paged, because the masthead pill and the Needs count answer before the page settles. They acknowledge the top item where it sits (press "2 No", answer d5, mark r7 read), watch it collapse to its receipt while a Hand line lands in Chat, and then read s1's cards and steer it from the composer.

The material is a quiet review palette: a near-white ground, pale grey cards on hairline rules and near-black ink, with a GitHub-dark night theme whose cards sit one step above the ground. Accent blue marks the operator's own card, focus, links and the working pulse. Fail red is kept for trouble. Severity lives in pale header fills on bordered items, and every state carries a word and an icon shape as well as a colour. Type is the system sans at five sizes; mono is kept for refs, code, keys, terminal text, severity codes and live figures. The fleet tint touches only the mark and a 3px rule across the top.

The desk refuses the chat-ops shell of sidebar, chat and inspector, and it refuses the green-on-black terminal opposite. Every page shows one fleet. At 1024px and wider, Chat is a 760px main column of thread cards with the composer pinned beneath it, and Needs is a rail on the right. Below that width, the same two panels sit behind two tabs, Needs and Chat.
keyCharacteristics: A near-white ground (`bg`) with pale grey cards (`card`) on hairlines (`line`) by day, and `#0d1117` with cards raised to `#161b22` at night.
One severity ramp orders Needs, fills each item's header, and colours the Needs counts.
Every state is a word plus an icon shape plus a colour, never colour alone.
Chat is a thread of bordered cards: the supervisor on the left, the operator on the right on accent-bg, and Hand's own events as one-line ringed notes.
Acknowledge in place: a pressed key collapses its item to "Sent 2 · waiting…", and every action leaves a receipt, a Hand line and a link back.
A 44px masthead that answers the supervisor's state, model and context window.
Five type sizes, tabular numerals for live figures, no web fonts, and a strict CSP.

rules.name: The Red Is Trouble Rule
rules.body: Fail red marks only what blocks or has broken: a blocked screen, a failure, an interrupted or unreachable supervisor, a context window at 90%, the auto-deny countdown and an error, plus the two controls that end a turn. Decisions, reports, links and ordinary states never take it.

rules.name: The Word And Shape Rule
rules.body: A state is never colour alone. The masthead pill carries an icon and a word, each Needs header carries an icon and a severity code, and each task row carries its state icon.

rules.name: The Tint Stays Put Rule
rules.body: The fleet tint colours the mark and the masthead's 3px top rule. It never fills a surface or colours copy.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: Every pixel font size is 22, 16, 15, 14 or 12px. `TestTypeHasFiveSteps` fails on any other. Inline code in replies sets at 85% of its line, and inputs rise to 16px on coarse pointers so a phone never zooms.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Figures that update in place are set in tabular numerals so the row never shifts: the `.live` class (the context figure, the countdown), every `time`, counts, meta and refs.

rules.name: The Rail At Desk Width Rule
rules.body: Needs is a rail only from 1024px (`TestNeedsIsARailAtDeskWidth`); below it the tabs stay (`TestTabsBelowDeskWidth`) and each panel is held to the 760px column.

rules.name: The Five Regions Rule
rules.body: The fleet page updates live through exactly five regions, `status`, `console`, `timeline`, `queue` and `tasks`, and the composer form sits outside every region so a live update never takes the operator's draft.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces carry a hairline and no shadow. `TestTheOnCallPalette` fails on any `box-shadow` outside the composer box, the menus, the toast, the keys and `kbd`.

dos: **Do** take every colour from the custom properties in `board.css` (`var(--fail)`, `var(--accent-bg)`), and give any new token both a light and a dark value that keeps 4.5:1 for text.
**Do** order anything that needs the operator by the severity ramp in `internal/board/queue.go`, and fill its header with its tone's pale fill.
**Do** give every state a word and an icon shape as well as its colour.
**Do** keep font sizes to 22, 16, 15, 14 and 12px, and set figures that update in place in tabular numerals.
**Do** leave a trace for every action: a receipt, a Hand line in Chat, and a link back to the item.
**Do** keep one primary button per form, and keep Stop behind a second press.
**Do** keep all style in `board.css` and all script in `app.js`: no inline script, no inline style and no `style` attribute.
**Do** stop every animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`: the working pulse, the feed, the arrival wash and the open and close transition.
donts: **Don't** use fail red for decisions, reports, links or ordinary states.
**Don't** put a shadow on a resting surface; only the open menus and the toast lift.
**Don't** colour copy or fill a surface with the fleet tint.
**Don't** bring back the newsroom words (WIRE, FLASH, BULLETIN, URGENT, ROUTINE, SERVICE, dispatch, news budget, tray) or the canary, carbon, ink band, `h-*` and `pencil` tokens.
**Don't** load web fonts or images from the stylesheet.
**Don't** draw an icon as a text glyph or pull in an icon library; add it to `icons.html` in the 16px, 1.5-stroke family.
**Don't** show the Needs rail below 1024px, and don't switch tabs for the operator.
**Don't** build a chat-ops shell of sidebar, chat and inspector, or a green-on-black terminal look beyond the screen excerpt.
